pages.text: Old pacts break. New ones are sealed in blood, root and flame. Thirteen new cards, three new ways to play, and a wheel of counters that turns every faction against another.

items.name: Lords
items.text: While a lord stands, every creature of its faction you control is stronger, the lord included. Bring it down and the whole army shrinks.

items.name: Faction sweeps
items.text: Spells that strike every creature of one faction at once, on both sides of the table. Know what your opponent plays.

items.name: Back from the grave
items.text: Wake the Dead returns the last two creatures that fell to your graveyard. They rise without their entry abilities.

pages.title: The counter wheel
pages.text: Every faction now holds an answer to another. Fire burns the grove, roots crack iron, cold iron silences spells, light banishes the dead, and darkness smothers the flame.

items.text: Too much trample, too soon. Now a late-game legend.
